holder-quote: He’d seen Mars kill a [Geomancer] in battle, but she hadn’t used that Skill. She hadn’t had to. She’d just charged through everything; her armor was impenetrable as far as Trey had seen. The Quarass shook her head, indicating Mars.
effect-quote: She may use it six times for every time a lesser [Warrior] would. This army she could destroy herself if she had time.
